title: Sautéed Kale
description: A simple, savory kale side dish cooked with garlic, stock, and red-wine vinegar until tender and flavorful.

ingredients.name: kale
ingredients.quantity: 1 large bunch, stems removed, leaves coarsely chopped

steps.instruction: Heat the olive oil in a large sauté pan over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Add the sliced garlic and cook until softened and fragrant.
Add the chopped kale to the pan and increase the heat to high.
Pour in the vegetable stock, then toss the kale to coat in the oil and liquid.
Cover the pan and cook for 5 to 7 minutes until the kale is tender but still bright green.
Remove the lid and continue cooking, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has fully evaporated, about 1 to 2 minutes.
Season with salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes to taste.
Add the red-wine vinegar, toss to combine, and serve.
